props.name: autofocus
props.description: Whether to focus the search input automatically on mount.

props.name: class
props.description: Class applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: classes
props.description: Family slot class defaults for this instance.

props.name: closeIcon
props.description: Icon name for the palette close button.

props.name: closeOnSelect
props.description: Whether to request closing the palette after an enabled item is selected.

props.name: disableFilter
props.description: Disable built-in search filtering and render all provided items.

props.name: emptyRender
props.description: Custom empty state renderer.

props.name: filterItems
props.description: Custom filter function that fully controls which groups and items are visible.

props.name: footerRender
props.description: Custom footer renderer.

props.name: getItemSearchText
props.description: Custom search text builder for built-in filtering.

props.name: groups
props.description: Command groups to display initially.

props.name: inputProps
props.description: Additional attributes for the search input.

props.name: inputRef
props.description: Ref forwarded to the inner search `<input>` element.

props.name: itemProps
props.description: Additional attributes for a command row.

props.name: itemRender
props.description: Custom command row content renderer.

props.name: leadingIcon
props.description: Icon name of input's leading icon.

props.name: listboxProps
props.description: Additional attributes for the command listbox.

props.name: loading
props.description: Whether the palette is in a loading state.

props.name: loadingIcon
props.description: Icon name of input's leading icon for the loading state.

props.name: onClose
props.description: Callback triggered when the close button is clicked or selection requests closing.

props.name: onSearchTermChange
props.description: Callback triggered when the search term changes.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback triggered when an enabled item is selected.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Placeholder text for the search input.

props.name: ref
props.description: Ref forwarded to the root `<div>` element.

props.name: scrollToItem
props.description: Scrolls a highlighted command into view using its flattened entry index.

props.name: searchMaxLength
props.description: Maximum allowed length for the search text.

props.name: searchTerm
props.description: Controlled search term.

props.name: showClose
props.description: Whether to show a close button in the header.

props.name: style
props.description: Style applied to the component root or trigger element.

props.name: styles
props.description: Family slot style defaults for this instance.

props.name: virtualRender
props.description: Renders flattened group labels and commands through a virtualization layer.

props.name: alwaysShow
props.description: Whether this item should be excluded from built-in search filtering.

props.name: description
props.description: Secondary description text shown for the item.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Whether the item is disabled and cannot be selected.

props.name: keywords
props.description: Additional keywords included in built-in search matching.

props.name: label
props.description: Primary label for the item.

props.name: leadingRender
props.description: Custom visual rendered at the start of the item.

props.name: onSelect
props.description: Callback triggered when the item is selected.

props.name: trailingRender
props.description: Custom visual rendered at the end of the item.

props.name: value
props.description: Unique value for the item.
